reference_audio.note: Voice cloning conditions on the audio alone — no transcript needed.  Only the first 15 s of the clip are used (the engine hard-cuts longer ones).  For emotion control, send emotion_audio_base64 (a second clip), emotion_vector (8 components) or emotion_text (QwenEmotion; server must be started with INDEXTTS_USE_QWEN_EMO=1) — at most one per request.

parameters.name: audio_base64
parameters.description: Reference voice sample (roughly 5-10 s works well) as a base64 string.  Any container soundfile can decode (WAV, MP3, OGG, FLAC, ...).  Only the first 15 s are used — the engine hard-cuts longer clips.  No transcript is needed.

parameters.name: language
parameters.description: Two-letter language code (supported: ar, en, es, ja, zh).  Omitted or empty defaults to 'en'.

parameters.name: seed
parameters.description: Random seed for reproducibility.  If omitted, a random seed in [1, 1000] is chosen and echoed in the response.

parameters.name: emotion_audio_base64
parameters.description: Optional second reference clip whose *emotion* to adopt, as a base64 string (the voice itself still comes from audio_base64). Use with emotion_alpha to blend; mutually exclusive with emotion_vector and emotion_text.

parameters.name: emotion_alpha
parameters.description: Strength of the emotion guidance.  With emotion_audio_base64: 0.0 keeps the speaker's own emotion, 1.0 fully adopts the emotion clip's.  With emotion_vector/emotion_text: scales the resulting emotion vector (1.0 = full strength).

parameters.name: emotion_vector
parameters.description: Optional 8-component emotion vector [happy, angry, sad, afraid, disgusted, melancholic, surprised, calm], each in [0.0, 1.0].  Mutually exclusive with emotion_audio_base64 and emotion_text.

parameters.name: emotion_text
parameters.description: Optional free-text description of the desired emotion (e.g. 'excited and cheerful'), converted to an emotion vector by the QwenEmotion model.  Requires the server to be started with INDEXTTS_USE_QWEN_EMO=1, otherwise requests are rejected with 400.  Mutually exclusive with the other emotion sources.

parameters.name: duration_factor
parameters.description: Length control for the output relative to natural speaking length (1.0 = natural; >1 stretches, <1 compresses).

parameters.name: temperature
parameters.description: Sampling temperature.  Omit for the engine default (0.8).

parameters.name: top_p
parameters.description: Nucleus sampling threshold.  Omit for the engine default (0.8).

parameters.name: top_k
parameters.description: Top-k sampling threshold.  Omit for the engine default (30).

parameters.name: repetition_penalty
parameters.description: Penalty applied to repeated tokens.  Omit for the engine default (10.0).
